judge.rationale: The candidate only finished the planning and red-test phase: it added `.lore/dod.md`, updated `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and created a failing acceptance test suite in `src/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`. No production code was touched at all (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `src/index.ts`, etc. are all unchanged). Because the acceptance test passes `{history: {enabled: true}}` to `createHalEngine` and expects `StoreCannotList` and `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` to exist, both `typecheck` and the test suite will fail immediately. While the candidate's DoD and test plan accurately identified all the seams and requirements from the issue, none of the implementation was actually carried out.
